question: Should WhatsApp phone-code pairing ship as this plugin-owned interactive choice, or should the supported public contract instead be the explicit `--phone-number` CLI shape proposed by the adjacent implementation?
rationale: Both open implementations target the same user problem but expose materially different operator interfaces, and selecting a durable channel-login contract requires maintainer intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt the plugin-owned interactive choice
options.body: Keep QR as the default, use the selector for phone-code pairing, and require the dependency authorization plus exact-head device proof before merge.

options.title: Standardize on an explicit CLI phone-number input
options.body: Pause this branch and converge on the adjacent flag-based design if non-interactive scripting is the intended public contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the plugin-owned interactive choice
recommendation.body: Keep QR as the default, use the selector for phone-code pairing, and require the dependency authorization plus exact-head device proof before merge.
